text.id: Replaces the Instrument Tree. Why the ol

g.text: Replaces the Instrument Tree. Why the old card was unclear, what changed, and exactly what a click does.

svg.text: Before and after

text.id: Numbers match: each fix answers the prob

svg.text: Numbers match: each fix answers the problem with the same number.
BEFORE
AFTER
Three fills — grey, pale grey, navy — with
no stated meaning. They read as three
states, so “selected” can't be told apart
from “container”.
The selected row copies the active tab pill
above it. Two “you are here” signals
compete for the same job.
Rows are indented pills of different widths,
which reads as a stack of buttons. Platform
→ module is only 12 px of indent.
The right column means three things: level
(“Platform”), category (“Air Quality”),
manufacturer (“Plantower”).
Modules contain sensors, but nothing says
so — no chevron, and no way to fold them.
Filled rows look like buttons; sensor rows
look like plain text. Which of these can you
click?
“Instrument tree” is system language, and
nothing says what a click will do.

g.text: Choose one to see its specs

svg.text: One selection style: navy tint + 3 px bar +
bold navy name. Every other row is unfilled.
Never colour alone.
Selection looks nothing like the tab pill. The
navigator picks what; the tabs pick which
aspect of it.
Full-width rows, content indented in 20 px
steps, with guide lines. Hierarchy comes
from position, not fill.
Right column removed. Each row's subtitle
says what it is: “Air quality · 2 sensors”,
Every parent has a chevron. The chevron
folds; clicking the row selects it and unfolds
it.
Every row shares one hover state and one
full-width hit area, so everything clickable
looks the same.
A plain title plus an instruction. The panel
answers with a header named after the row
you clicked.
What a click does

svg.text: The navigator sets the scope; the panel header names it. Same words, side by side.

WHEN YOU
THE NAVIGATOR
Click a row

text.id: Selects it. A parent also unfolds.

svg.text: Selects it. A parent also unfolds.
Click a chevron

text.id: Folds or unfolds only. The selection doe

svg.text: Folds or unfolds only. The selection does not move.

text.id: Fold a parent that holds the selection

svg.text: Fold a parent that holds the selection

text.id: Selection stays. The parent's name turns

svg.text: Selection stays. The parent's name turns navy and shows a dot.
Moves focus between visible rows.

text.id: Unfolds a parent, or steps into its firs

svg.text: Unfolds a parent, or steps into its first child.

text.id: Folds a parent, or steps out to the pare

svg.text: Folds a parent, or steps out to the parent.
Enter / Space
Selects the focused row.

svg.text: The selection lives in the URL (?component=aq-module-300), so all three keep it.
Window narrower than 1024 px
The navigator becomes a “Showing: AQ-Module 300” dropdown above the panel. Not drawn yet.
Why these choices
Visibility of system status

text.id: Nielsen heuristic 1. The panel header re

svg.text: Nielsen heuristic 1. The panel header repeats the exact name you clicked, so the result of every click

text.id: is visible where you're already looking.

svg.text: is visible where you're already looking.
Recognition rather than recall
Nielsen heuristic 6. “OX-B431” means nothing on its own; “O₃ · NO₂” underneath it does. Subtitles
say what each part measures.
Don't rely on colour alone

text.id: WCAG 1.4.1. Selection is carried by a ba

svg.text: WCAG 1.4.1. Selection is carried by a bar and a weight change as well as a tint, and levels by icon

text.id: shape — both survive greyscale and colou

svg.text: shape — both survive greyscale and colour-blindness.
Split select from fold

text.id: WAI-ARIA tree view pattern. Folding is n

svg.text: WAI-ARIA tree view pattern. Folding is navigation housekeeping; it must never change what the
panel shows.
Big, uniform targets

text.id: Fitts's law. Full-width rows give every

svg.text: Fitts's law. Full-width rows give every node the same generous hit area, instead of pills that shrink
as you go deeper.

text.id: If it needs a legend, fix the control

svg.text: If it needs a legend, fix the control

text.id: The old card needed a Tree Key to be und

svg.text: The old card needed a Tree Key to be understood. The new one doesn't, so the key is gone.
